name: Auto Frame Window
description: Measures every input's frame window automatically by replaying your bot macro.

max-shift.name: Max frames to test
max-shift.description: How many frames early and late each input is tested. Windows at the cap are marked as capped (could be bigger).

horizon.name: Frames to survive after input
horizon.description: A shifted input only counts if you survive this many frames after it. 240 = 1 second. Raise it if a late death caused by an earlier click gets missed.

measure-releases.name: Measure releases too
measure-releases.description: Also measure when you let go (matters for ship, wave, swing holds). Takes about twice as long.

frame-source.name: Frame counting
frame-source.description: How the macro's frames are matched to the game. Auto tries each option and picks the one where the macro beats the level.

frame-budget.name: Speed (ms per frame)
frame-budget.description: Milliseconds of simulation per rendered frame. Higher = faster but choppier screen.

cbf-beta.name: CBF precision (beta)
cbf-beta.description: BETA. Measures windows to a fraction of a frame by splitting the physics tick at the input, the way Click Between Frames does. Slower, and may desync on some gamemodes.

show-markers.name: Show click markers
show-markers.description: Pop a colored circle with the frame window where each click happens (needs a measured level).

show-hud.name: Show window HUD
show-hud.description: Top-right counter with one row per frame window (1 up to Max window shown), clicks passed / total. Applies on next level load.

show-next.name: Show next click
show-next.description: Adds a line to the HUD with the next click's window and how many frames away it is.

marker-detail.name: Marker detail
marker-detail.description: Show how many frames early / late each click can be under its marker, e.g. -1 +0.

max-shown-window.name: Max window shown
max-shown-window.description: Highest frame window shown (1 to 25). The top-right counter gets one row per window from 1 up to this, and markers, sounds and the Next line skip clicks above it. Applies on next level load for the counter.

sound-enabled.name: Click sounds
sound-enabled.description: Play your imported sound when you pass each measured click.

sound-any.name: Sound: any click
sound-any.description: Plays for every click that doesn't have its own sound below.

sound-4f.name: Sound: 4f+ clicks
sound-4f.description: Plays on clicks with a window of 4 frames or more.

sound-follow-sfx.name: Follow game SFX volume
sound-follow-sfx.description: Scale click sounds by the game's SFX volume slider.

section-start.name: Section start %
section-start.description: Only measure clicks from this % of the macro onward. Results merge with what's already saved, so long levels can be done in chunks.

section-end.name: Section end %
section-end.description: Only measure clicks up to this % of the macro.

lstar-hud.name: L* in HUD
lstar-hud.description: Which L* precision to show live in the HUD (so far / whole level). Off hides it.

lstar-target-hours.name: L* target time (hours)
lstar-target-hours.description: L* is the precision needed to beat the level in this much expected playtime. 24 = NaNDL default. Applies on next level load.

lstar-respawn.name: L* respawn time (s)
lstar-respawn.description: Seconds lost per death before the next attempt starts. Applies on next level load.

lstar-kt.name: Nerve constant (K_T)
lstar-kt.description: Higher = clicks later in the level weigh more. NaNDL default 0.0016520833717346.

lstar-ku.name: Fatigue constant (K_U)
lstar-ku.description: Higher = later clicks (by count) weigh more. NaNDL default 0.0002727763242154.

lstar-kc.name: CPS constant (K_C)
lstar-kc.description: Higher = fast clicking weighs more. NaNDL default 0.2784421686721826.

check-updates.name: Check for updates
check-updates.description: GitHub version only: on the main menu, check GitHub for a newer version and offer a one-click update. (The Geode index version is updated by Geode instead.)
